Mumbai, India’s largest and busiest city, ___________
_________________________________________________________.
This service is carried out by dedicated people
known as dabbawalas.
The delivery process begins early in the morning
when lunch boxes are collected by dabbawalas from
homes around Mumbai by 9:00 a.m. They are then
taken to the nearest train station. Each lunch box is
carefully placed on the right train heading in various
directions. By 12:30 p.m., the lunches have reached
their destinations in Mumbai, where they are
distributed to offices. The empty lunch boxes are
gathered by 5:00 p.m. and returned to their original
homes by following the same route in reverse.
Today, about 5,000 dabbawalas work in and
around Mumbai and manage about 400,000 lunch
box deliveries daily. This operation runs with
remarkable accuracy, achieving a 99.99% success
rate, which means just one error in every six million
deliveries. Dabbawalas have a simple but effective
color-coding system to ensure each lunch box
reaches its planned destination. Dabbawalas owe
their success to an efficient organization and a
strong sense of work. Accuracy is key, and their
cooperation and communication allow them to
function as efficiently as a well-organized machine.

금지하고 있습니다. 공통영어2 YBM(김은형) PROJECT1 예상문제 1회 - 객관식(선다형) 1. ④ 2. ③ 3. ②, ⑤ 4. ⑤ 5. ① 6. 주관식 7. ②, ④ 8. ④ 9. ③ 10. ② 정답 및 해설 ┃1회┃ 1) ④: 커뮤니티 매핑은 지역 문제를 해결하기 위해 지역 사회 구성원들이 지도를 만드는 협력적인 과정이라는 설명과 함께, 뉴욕시에 있는 모든 화장실에 대한 상호 작용형 지도를 개발한 임완수 박사의 뉴욕 화장실 프로젝트를 통해 특히 응급 상황에서 도시의 주민과 방문객들의 편 의를 크게 향상시켰다는 내용이 이어지므로, 지역 사회 에 도움이 되는 것이 목표라는 흐름으로 빈칸에는 ④ ‘지역 사회의 삶의 질을 향상시키는 것’이 알맞다. 오답 ① 전세계적 문제들을 협력적으로 해결하는 것 ② 응급 상황에서 방문객들을 돕는 것 ③ 주요 관광 명소들을 위한 지도를 만드는 것 ⑤ 주민들에게 개인 화장실을 짓도록 장려하는 것 2) ③: 지역 문제를 해결하기 위해 지역 사회 구성원들이 온라 인 지도 서비스와 다양한 도구를 사용하여 지도를 만드 는 협력적인 과정이라는 커뮤니티 매핑의 정의와 임완수 박사의 뉴욕 화장실 프로젝트라는 커뮤니티 매핑의 예시 가 이어지므로, 글의 제목으로 ③ ‘커뮤니티 매핑: 개념부 터 실천까지’가 알맞다. 오답 ① 상호 작용형 지도를 만드는 것의 중요성 significance 중요성 ② 임 박사의 뉴욕 화장실을 향상시키려는 노력 ④ 국제 사회를 더 좋게 만드는 방법 ⑤ 관광객들이 공중화장실을 쉽게 찾도록 도와주는 방법들 3) ②, ⑤ : ⓑ makes → (to) make (앞의 명사구 community mapping을 수식하는 형용사적 용법의 to부정사 to save 와 등위접속사 and로 병렬 연결되므로, 동사 makes를 to 부정사인 to make 또는 to가 생략된 동사원형 make로 고친다.) *본문에는 make가 쓰였음 ⓔ illustrating → illustrate (앞에 문장의 주어 The two examples above가 쓰였고, 뒤에 다른 동사 없이 목적어 its transformative ~ efforts가 이어지므로 문장의 동사 자리이다. 일반적인 설명에 해당하므로 현재시제를 써야 하므로, illustrating을 복수명사구인 주어에 수일치 시킨 illustrate로 고친다.) 오답 ⓐ 과거 시간을 나타내는 부사구 during the 2010 Haiti earthquake(2010년 아이티의 지진 발생 동안)와 함께 쓰 인 과거시제 occurred는 알맞다. ⓒ 전치사 in에 이어지는 동명사 assessing, locating과 ‘A, B, and C’의 형태로 병렬구조를 이루므로, 동명사 identifying 은 알맞다. ⓓ 뒤에 명사 area를 수식하는 분사 자리이며, area는 ‘영 향을 받은’ 대상이므로 수동을 나타내는 과거분사 affected는 알맞다. 4) ⑤: 또 다른 주목할 만한 사례는 2010년 아이티의 지진 동 안 일어났다는 주어진 문장 다음에, 이 지진을 the disaster(그 재난)로 가리켜 그 재난 발생 직후 자원봉사 자와 설립자들이 지진에 영향을 받은 지역의 지도를 만 들기 위해 위성 이미지를 활용했다는 (C), 그들의 행동을 This collaborative effort(이러한 공동의 노력)로 가리켜 그것이 어떤 역할을 했는지를 설명하는 (B), 지진에 대응 한 공동의 노력을 This rapid response(이 신속한 대응)으 로 가리켜 커뮤니티 매핑의 잠재력을 언급하는 (A)로 이 어지는 것이 자연스럽다. 5) ①: ⓐ 완전한 절(community ~ tools)을 이끌어 선행사 a collaborative process를 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 관계부 사 where가 알맞다. 본문변형 in which →where ⓑ made와 목적어 it에 이어져 ‘make+목적어+목적격보어 (~을 …하게 만들다)’의 5형식 구문을 이루는 목적격보어 자리로, make는 목적격보어로 형용사를 취하는 동사이므로 형용사 the locations of public restrooms. : <조건>에 따라 분사구문으로 시작하되, 의미상의 주어가 주절의 주어와 동일한 he이며, ‘사용하는’ 주체이므로 제시 된 동사 use를 능동의 의미를 나타내는 현재분사 Using으 로 변형하고 목적어인 명사구 online maps를 쓴다. 7) ②, ④ : 커뮤니티 매핑은 지역 사회의 삶의 질을 향상시키려는 목 표로 지역 사회 내의 개인들이 협력적으로 정보를 수집, 시각화하고 공유하는 것을 가능하게 한다고 했으므로, ② ‘지역 사회 구성원들은 커뮤니티 매핑에 의해 생활환경을 더 낫게 만들기 위해 정보를 수집, 시각화하고 공유하는 데에 협력할 수 있는 힘을 부여받는다.’는 일치 내용이다. 지도 제작 과정은 다수의 지역 사회 구성원들의 적극적인 참여 덕분에 한 달 만에 완료되었다고 했으므로, ④ ‘많은 지역 사회 구성원들의 적극적인 참여 때문에, 지도 제작 과정은 끝내는 데 단지 한 달 걸렸다.’는 일치 내용이다. 오답 ① 커뮤니티 매핑은 오락을 위해 예술적인 지도를 그리는 공동의 노력이다. (→ 커뮤니티 매핑은 지역 문제를 해결하 기 위해 지역 사회 구성원들이 온라인 지도 서비스와 다 공통영어2 YBM(김은형) PROJECT1 예상문제 1회 - 주관식(서답형) 6. Using online maps, he carefully identified and marked the locations of public restrooms. 양한 도구를 사용하여 지도를 만드는 협력적인 과정이다.) ③ 임 박사는 뉴욕시에 있는 모든 화장실의 온라인 지도 를 만들고 동료들과 지인들에게만 공개했다. (→ 임 박사는 뉴욕시에 있는 모든 화장실에 대한 상호 작용형 지도를 개발하고 누구에게나 접근 가능하도록 만들었다.) acquaintance 지인 ⑤ 상호명, 주소, 이용 가능 정보 및 영업시간과 같은 필수 세부 정보를 수집하는 것은 주민들이 긴급 상황을 대처하 는 데 힘들게 만들었다. (→ 이 노력, 즉 세부 정보를 수집 하는 노력은 특히 응급 상황에서 도시의 주민과 방문객들 의 편의를 크게 향상시켰다.) demanding 힘든, 고된 8) ④: ⓓ more delayed(더 지연된) → faster(더 빠른) 9) ③: 지도 제작 과정은 한 달 만에 많은 지역 사회 구성원들 덕분에 완료되었고, 이는 상호명, 주소, 이용 가능 정보 등과 같은 세부 정보 수집을 포함했다는 흐름이므로, 뉴 욕시에서 공중화장실을 찾기 어렵다는 문제를 제기하는 (C) ‘다른 대도시들과 비교하여, 뉴욕시에 있는 공중 화장 실은 대부분이 공원 안에 위치해 있기 때문에 찾기 어렵 다.’는 흐름상 관계없는 문장이다. 10) ②: 요약문 2010년 아이티 지진 이후 오픈스트리트맵 단체 의 사람들은 48시간 이내에 유용한 정보를 포함하여 (A)피해를 입은 지역의 지도를 제작했으며, 커뮤니티 매핑이 어떻게 응급 상황에서 생명을 구하고 복구를 (B)빠르게 할 수 있는 지를 보여준다. 오답 ① 안전한 가속화하다 ③ 복구된 촉진시키다 ④ 영향을 받은 늦추다 ⑤ 위험한 지연시키다

body:
B1 (MC): Today’s topic is whether AI is beneficial to
humanity or not. Who wants to start?
G1 (Debater 1): I think that AI is beneficial to
humanity because it can automate repetitive
tasks. It ⓐincreases productivity and reduces
errors.
B2 (Debater 2): I think so too. The use of AI is
making processes in various industries ⓑmore
efficient.
B1: Any other thoughts? What is your opinion?
G2 (Debater 3): In my opinion, if we adopt AI too
much, people can lose their jobs.
B2: But AI can ⓒlimit new job opportunities in
various
fields
like
data
analysis,
machine
learning, and so on.
G2: You have a point there, but I’m more concerned
than excited when it comes to AI. From my
perspective, we need to ⓓregulate AI development
carefully.
B3 (Debater 4): I want to add to the discussion by
emphasizing the ⓔethical concerns surrounding
AI. While using AI is more efficient and
convenient, we must also think about its impact
on privacy, bias, and accountability.
G1: That’s a good point. I think the development of
AI really gives us a lot to think about. It’s
important to keep talking about it.
B1: You’re right. Your thoughts all make sense and
give us something to think about. Let’s each
think about it a little more and discuss it when
we see one another the next time. Thank you,
everyone, for your valuable opinions.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

Klara is an AF (Artificial Friend), a companion robot
for
children.
She
is
solar-powered.
She
stays
(A)[healthy / healthily] when she gets the Sun’s
nourishment but feels weak and lifeless without
sunlight. At the robot store, she enjoyed taking in
the outside world from the windows. Klara closely
observed (B)[that / what] she saw, hoping to learn
everything necessary to be a caring and helpful AF.
One evening, she discovered that a homeless man
was lying on the street without moving. Klara was
sad as she believed he had died. But the next
morning when the Sun was shining, she was
surprised to see that the homeless man was sitting
up and stroking his dog. Klara believed the Sun
(C)[has saved / had saved] him and came to have
strong
faith
in
the
Sun’s
power
to
restore
everything.
(A)
(B)
(C)
choices: healthy     what   has saved
healthy     that   had saved
healthily     that   has saved
healthy     what   had saved
healthily     what   had saved
solution: (A) ‘(어떤 상태를) 유지하다, ~인 채로 있다’를 뜻하는 2형식 동사 stay의 보어 자리이므로, 형용사 healthy가 알맞다. 참고 로, 보어 자리에 부사는 쓸 수 없다.. (B) 동사 saw의 목적어가 없는 불완전한 절을 이끌어, 동사 observed의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루어야 하므로, 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 알맞다. (C) 태양이 노숙자를 ‘구했던’ 것은 클라라가 믿었던(believed) 것보다 더 먼저 일어난 일이므로 과거완료 had saved가 알맞다. YBM(김은형) 4과

body:
One day, a fourteen-year-old girl named Josie
visited the shop with her mother, Chrissie. Josie
chatted with Klara joyfully. Josie immediately took a
ⓐ[dislike / liking] to Klara and asked whether Klara
wanted to be her friend.
Josie: I really want you to come to my home. I think
you’ll like my room, and we’ll see the beautiful
sunset from the windows there. We can do all
the great things together all the time while
I’m growing up. You want to come, right?
Klara: (nodding hopefully)
Josie: That’s so good, but I want to be honest with
you. I know how ⓑ[awful / pleased] you’ll
feel after people promise you perfect things
and they turn out not to be so. Some days
I’m not so healthy or happy. I do not know
why. Do you still want to come, Klara?
Klara: If there’s anything difficult or scary, we will
face it together.
To show that she would do her best to be Josie’s
friend, Klara held her hands together and shook
them slightly. Pleased by (A)___________________________
_____________, Josie asked Chrissie for her permission
to buy the AF. Chrissie asked Klara what she had
observed about Josie, and found Klara to be
ⓒ[hardly / remarkably] observant. After requesting
that Klara continue to care about Josie, Chrissie
agreed to buy Klara and took her home.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

ⓐ
ⓑ
ⓒ
choices: liking  awfulremarkably
dislike  awfulremarkably
dislike  pleasedhardly
liking  pleasedremarkably
liking  awfulhardly
solution: ⓐ 조시는 클라라와 즐겁게 이야기를 나눴다는 내용에 이어지 고 있으며, 클라라에게 자신의 친구가 되고 싶은지 물었다는 내용이 이어지므로, 조시는 즉시 클라라를 마음에 들어 했다는 흐름으로 ‘liking(좋아함)’이 알맞다. ⓑ 조시가 클라라에게 자신은 솔직하고 싶다는 내용에 이어지 고 있으므로, 완벽한 것을 약속하고 그것이 그렇지 않은 것으 로 밝혀질 때 기분이 얼마나 나쁠지 안다는 흐름으로 ‘awful (끔찍한)’이 알맞다. ⓒ 크리시는 클라라에게 조시에 대해 무엇을 관찰했는지 물었 다는 내용에 이어지고 있으므로, 클라라가 관찰력이 매우 뛰어 나다는 것을 알게 되어 계속 조시를 관찰해 달라고 하면서 그 녀를 구입하는 것에 동의하고 집으로 데려갔다는 흐름으로 ‘remarkably(놀랄 만큼)’가 알맞다.

learned.

have been afraid of losing Josie ever since
I lost Sal. That is why I agreed with you
on this replica, but ⓑhowever well you

Capaldi: You must not lose faith, Chrissie. The survey
Klara has successfully completed ⓒis clear
evidence that she is already well on her

and desires. You believe that there is
something unreachable inside each of us,
something
that
is
unique
and
won’t
transfer. But there is nothing like that. The

have every right to love her just as you

Josie. She may overcome her illness. If the
day comes when you do need the new Josie,
I will do my best to become as ⓔclose to
her as possible. However, it is wrong to give
up hope already.

What do Capaldi and Chrissie want Klara to dowith everything she has learned about Josie?

What fear does Klara reveal at the end of theconversation?

Klara is an AF (Artificial Friend), a companion robot
for children. She is solar-powered. She stays healthy
when she gets the Sun’s nourishment but feels
weak and lifeless without sunlight. At the robot
store, she enjoyed taking in the outside world from
the windows. (A)클라라는 배려하고 도움이 되는 AF가
되기 위해서 필요한 모든 것을 배우기를 희망하면서,
자신이 본 것을 면밀히 관찰했다. One evening, she
discovered that a homeless man was lying on the
street without moving. Klara was sad as she
believed he had died. But the next morning when
the Sun was shining, she was surprised to see that
the homeless man was sitting up and stroking his
dog. Klara believed the Sun had saved him and
came to have strong faith in the Sun’s power to
restore everything.

why trusting the Sun’s power too much is dangerous

Trisha Prabhu, a young computer scientist from
the U.S., is fighting cyberbullying with her innovative
application ReThink. ReThink is a virtual keyboard
that uses artificial intelligence to detect potentially
hurtful text messages before they are sent and
prompts young people to pause and reconsider
their words. When a user types a message that
contains potentially offensive language, such as “I
hate you,” ReThink prompts: “Hold on! Are you sure
you want to say that?” or, “Remember. You are
what you type!”
In 2014, when Trisha was just thirteen years old,
she read the tragic news of a twelve-year-old girl
who had been cyberbullied for over a year and a
half. Shocked at the story, she decided to prevent
cyberbullying by using technology and created
ReThink. ReThink has been used by schools and
organizations worldwide and has successfully raised
awareness on cyberbullying. It has helped young
people make better decisions in digital space where
people could easily be unkind toward each other. In
fact, it has been found that when using ReThink,
adolescents change their minds 93% of the time
and decide not to post offensive messages.

ReThink: The Application That Promote the Useof Offensive Language
Improving Cyberbullying Prevention Strategies forTeachers with ReThink

Appropriate technology refers to technological
solutions that are designed to suitably meet the
specific needs of a community. Such technologies
typically utilize locally available resources, so they
reduce costs and promote local industries. These
technologies are environmentally sustainable because
they rely on renewable resources. Additionally, their
designs are (A)[easy / difficult] to use, which allows
local communities to maintain the technologies
without specialized training.
The Warka Tower is one good example of
appropriate technology. This tower helps with the
lack of clean water in many regions. It employs
(B)[artificial / natural] processes to deliver 100 liters
of clean water daily. It gathers rainwater in a pot at
its base. Additionally, the tower captures fog and
changes it into water drops that collect on nets,
and then the water drops fall into the pot. One of
the tower’s strengths is that it is simple. A small
team can construct it in just one day by using
eco-friendly materials like soil, wood, and natural
fiber nets. Truly, the Warka Tower demonstrates
how appropriate technology can solve (C)[national /
regional] issues in a way that is affordable, effective,
and eco-friendly.
(A)
(B)
(C)
choices: easy  naturalnational

solution: (A) 전문적인 교육 없이 기술을 유지할 수 있다는 내용이 이어지므로, 적정 기술의 설계는 사용이 쉽다는 흐름으로 ‘easy(쉬운)’가 알맞다. (B) 바닥에 있는 냄비에 빗물을 모으고 안개를 포집하여 그물 에 모이는 물방울로 변화시킨다는 내용이 이어지므로, 깨끗한 물을 얻기 위해 자연 공정을 사용한다는 흐름으로 ‘natural(자 연의)’이 알맞다. (C) 적정 기술이란 지역 사회의 특정한 요구를 적합하게 충족 하도록 설계된 기술적 해결책이며, 그 예 중 하나인 와카 타워 도 많은 지역의 물 부족 문제를 해결하는 데 도움을 주므로, 적정 기술이 지역 문제를 해결할 수 있다는 흐름으로 ‘regional(지역[지방]의)’이 알맞다.

In 1768, Hwang Yun-seok, a scholar, made a diary
entry after taking the gwageo, a public service
entrance exam. He wrote (A)[what / that] he and
his friends had ordered a delivery of naengmyeon
for lunch. Hwang’s diary is the first historical
ⓐdocument indicating Koreans have been delivering
food for at least two and a half centuries.
During the Joseon period, ⓑspecialized people called
jeonin delivered letters for a fee. In the days before
the modern address systems, letters were delivered
by name and place of residence, so a jeonin had to
know the local areas like the back of his hand. Service
prices were determined by schedule and distance.
During the Japanese colonial period, Seoul’s streets
were filled with delivery professionals called “messengers,”
most working for a company (B)[was named / named]
Yongdalsa. Many used bikes to speed up delivery.
When customers ⓒcontacted Yongdalsa, a messenger
went to pick up the item and then delivered it.
Delivery mistakes were rare. Messengers were sometimes
ⓓcharged with carrying large bundles of cash, but
they were unfailingly honest and accurate. Customers
trusted the messengers so much that they often did
not check the items they (C)[were received /
received]. This messenger service was unique to
Korea and was based on a culture of ⓔmutual
trust and a hunger for speed. It is possible that this
paved the way for modern motorcycle delivery.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로바르게 연결된 것은?

(C)

thatnamedreceived
thatwas namedreceived
thatnamedwere received
whatnamedreceived
solution: (A) 동사 wrote의 목적어 자리에서 완전한 절(he and his friends ~ for lunch)을 이끌고 있으므로 명사절 접속사 that이 적절하다. (B) 전치사 for의 목적어인 명사구 a company를 수식하는 분사구 를 이루는 분사 자리이며, 수식을 받는 명사구 a company가 Yongdalsa라고 ‘이름이 지어진’ 대상으로, 뒤에 ‘name A B(A를 B라고 이름을 짓다)’에서 동사 name의 목적어 없이 목적격보어 (B)인 Yongdalsa가 바로 이어지므로, 수동 표현인 ‘A be named B(A가 B라고 이름 지어지다)’의 과거분사 named가 적절하다. (C) 완전한 절(they often did not check the items)에 they를 주어로 하는 다른 절이 접속사 없이 연결될 수 없으므로, they 이하는 앞의 명사구 the items를 수식하는 관계사절이며, 목적 격 관계대명사 which 또는 that이 생략된 것을 알 수 있다. 따 라서 목적어가 없는 불완전한 절의 형태가 되어야 하므로, 목 적어 없이 쓰인 능동태 과거시제인 received가 알맞다.

languages or a child who demonstrates surprising
mathematical skills. These unusually talented children
may seem like something out of a science-fiction
novel, but gene-editing technology has the potential
to transform such fiction into reality.
The CRISPR gene-editing tool, introduced in 2012,
was developed to cure previously incurable diseases
by targeting and modifying specific genes. While
this may seem promising, applying this technology
to unborn babies raises ethical and social problems.
For example, the birth of customized babies could
intensify social unfairness if these techniques are
only accessible to rich individuals or countries.
Moreover, CRISPR can introduce errors during
editing, potentially affecting an individual’s future
health.

continue
to
improve, it has not yet achieved error-free accuracy.

Katherine’s remarkable calculations by hand were
trusted more than digital computers. In early 1962,
John Glenn, one of the pioneering American
astronauts, ⓐwere preparing to orbit the Earth for
the first time in American history. NASA used an
electronic computer, first introduced into the space

trajectory, but it made many minor errors. Glenn,
who was concerned about its accuracy, asked
Katherine Johnson ⓑto double-check the machine’s
figures by hand. “If she says the numbers are
good,” he said, “I’m good to go.”
ⓒUsing only a pencil and a slide rule, Katherine
spent a day and a half checking the calculations
and finally made sure of them. Eventually, Glenn
became the first American astronaut to orbit the
Earth. Katherine was also part of the team that
performed calculations for Apollo 11, which sent the
first three men to the Moon in 1969, and even the
plan to put people on Mars, ⓓthat is still being
worked on today.
Katherine retired in 1986 after thirty-three years at
NASA. After that, she dedicated the rest of her life
ⓔto championing access to *STEM education for
Black girls. For her contributions, President Barack
Obama awarded her the Presidential Medal of
Freedom in 2015 and said, “Katherine G. Johnson
refused to be limited by society’s expectations of
her
gender
and
race
while

the
boundaries of humanity’s reach.” In 2017, NASA
dedicated a building in her honor in Virginia and
named it the Katherine G. Johnson Computational
Research Facility. She died on February 24, 2020, at
the age of 101, but her pioneering legacy will never
be forgotten.
*STEM: science, technology, engineering, and mathematics

typically utilize locally available resources, so they
reduce costs and promote local industries. These
technologies are environmentally sustainable because

communities to maintain the technologies without
specialized training.
The Warka Tower is one good example of
appropriate technology. This tower helps with the
lack of clean water in many regions. It employs
natural processes to deliver 100 liters of clean water
daily. It gathers rainwater in a pot at its base.
(B)___________________, the tower captures fog and
changes it into water drops that collect on nets,
and then the water drops fall into the pot. One of
the tower’s strengths is that it is simple. A small
team can construct it in just one day by using
eco-friendly materials like soil, wood, and natural
fiber nets. Truly, the Warka Tower demonstrates
how appropriate technology can solve local issues
in
a

that
is
affordable,
effective,
and
eco-friendly.

hand.

ⓐwhich lunch boxes are collected by ㉠them from
